_comment: Affiliate links and earning potential. `payout`/`potential`/`badge` drive the editor's money overlay (npm run edit). `potential` is a planning judgment about what one conversion is worth to you (high/medium/low/none), not a promise; re-rate it once real conversion data exists. `status` tracks the application separately.

instrumentl.name: Instrumentl
instrumentl.terms: Commissions confirmed, rate not public. [FACT-CHECK: confirm at signup]
instrumentl.potentialNote: Highest-value product in your strongest category ($2.1k-$6k/yr plans). Confirm the rate at signup.

grantstation.name: GrantStation
grantstation.terms: Product Referral Program (PRP), free to join. Written for associations/alliances; apply and ask. [FACT-CHECK: confirm at signup]
grantstation.payout: Product Referral Program, terms not public
grantstation.potentialNote: The product is only ~$199/yr, so any percentage is small. Volume play at best.

donordock.name: DonorDock
donordock.terms: $500 per new paid customer; referral gets 10% off. [FACT-CHECK: confirm at signup]
donordock.potentialNote: Largest flat payout on the site, and an easy self-serve signup.

4agoodcause.name: 4aGoodCause
4agoodcause.terms: 25%, recurring on every renewal. [FACT-CHECK: confirm at signup]
4agoodcause.potentialNote: Recurring forever, so it compounds. Rare in this space.

donorbox.name: Donorbox
donorbox.terms: 15% of fees, 3 yrs, 45-day cookie, $50 min payout. Attribution is link-only and never retroactive. [FACT-CHECK: confirm at signup]
donorbox.potentialNote: Recurring for three years, but a share of platform fees only. Best on high-volume shops. Link-only attribution: never mention Donorbox without the /go/ link.

givewp.name: GiveWP
givewp.terms: 30% first 24 referrals, then 40%. [FACT-CHECK: confirm at signup]
givewp.potentialNote: Rate rises with volume. WordPress shops only.

jotform.name: Jotform
jotform.terms: 30%, first year, ~1 day approval. [FACT-CHECK: confirm at signup]
jotform.potentialNote: Approves in about a day, so it is the fastest path to a live link. Entry plans are cheap, so per-sale is modest.

bloomerang.name: Bloomerang
bloomerang.terms: $250 per closed referral. [FACT-CHECK: confirm at signup]
bloomerang.potentialNote: Flat and large. CRM deals close slowly, so expect a lag.

donorsnap.name: DonorSnap
donorsnap.terms: $200 per paying customer, monthly, US/CA. [FACT-CHECK: confirm at signup]

kindsight.name: Kindsight
kindsight.terms: Tier B: negotiated consulting partner program (formerly iWave). No signup form; email partnerships. [FACT-CHECK: confirm terms with partnerships manager]
kindsight.payout: No program yet — negotiated consulting partnership
kindsight.potentialNote: Earns nothing today, but $4k-$6k contracts make it the best thing on the site to negotiate once you have real traffic.

donorsearch.name: DonorSearch
donorsearch.terms: Tier B: negotiated consulting partner program. No signup form; email partnerships. [FACT-CHECK: confirm terms with partnerships manager]
donorsearch.payout: No program yet — negotiated consulting partnership
donorsearch.potentialNote: Earns nothing today. Same high-ACV negotiation target as Kindsight.

neoncrm.name: Neon One
neoncrm.terms: Tier B: CAP program relaunched Oct 2025 — 10% discount on referred sales, commissions 'available'. [FACT-CHECK: confirm terms with partnerships manager]
neoncrm.payout: CAP program: commissions 'available', terms not public
neoncrm.potentialNote: Relationship program. Worth asking about once you have traffic.

zeffy.potentialNote: No affiliate program exists. Covered for credibility, and it will never earn. Do not build a page around it expecting revenue.

grantable.name: Grantable
grantable.readerOffer: 50% off first year for nonprofits under $500k budget
grantable.terms: No confirmed commission program. grantable.co/affiliates now redirects to their contact page, and grantable.co/partners describes only reciprocal visibility ('we feature you on our site, you feature us on yours'), with no commission terms. Search engines still index an old affiliate page, so a program likely existed at some point. Verified 2026-07-31.
grantable.potentialNote: Earns nothing today. The affiliates page is gone and the live partners page offers cross-promotion only. Worth one email to hello@grantable.co asking whether the affiliate program still exists, but do not plan revenue on it.

monday.terms: Self-serve via PartnerStack; vendor page says tiered rewards up to 100% of first-year sales. Base rate and cookie window shown at signup. [FACT-CHECK: confirm at signup]
monday.payout: Up to 100% of first-year sales (tiered, PartnerStack)
monday.potentialNote: Base rate not published; tiers reward volume.
